paragraphs: Tanhum. R' Avdumi bar Sanhum. Yuhasin brings R' Yishmael bar Tanhum; R' Muna bar Tanhum; R' Mana bar Tanhum; R' Menahem bar Tanhum; R' Shmuel bar Tanhum. [Glosses: Tanhum. Shevuot 36, end of side a: Tanhum bar Hakhinai. It seems to me that it should read Hanilai. That matter appears in Kiddushin 62 and Sotah 17; it requires examination there. ל״ת [provisionally: not corrected]. In Yevamot 62b: “R' Tanhum said: R' Hanila'ah said.” It seems to me that it should read bar Hanila'ah. ל״ת [provisionally: not corrected].]
